options: acknowledges individual ability while downplaying its uniqueness
is rejected by most historians of science
denies that talent plays any role in science
questions.explanation: ‘does not deny the importance of individual talent, but …’

questions.stem: The concert was cancelled because very few tickets had been sold.
options: The concert took place even though few tickets were sold.
Very few people went to the concert because it was cancelled.
The concert was cancelled, although many tickets had been sold.
The tickets were not sold because the concert had been cancelled.
Since hardly anyone had bought tickets, the concert did not take place.
questions.explanation: Neden (az bilet) → sonuç (iptal) ilişkisi korunmalı.

questions.stem: Most people in the town work in the tourism industry.
options: The majority of the town’s residents are employed in tourism.
All of the people in the town work in tourism.
Tourism is the only industry in the town.
Few residents of the town work in tourism.
Most tourists visit the town to work.
questions.explanation: ‘Most’ = ‘the majority’; kapsam korunmalı.

questions.stem: You cannot enter the laboratory without wearing protective glasses.
options: Protective glasses are not needed in the laboratory.
The laboratory sells protective glasses at the entrance.
You can wear protective glasses if you want in the laboratory.
Only scientists wear protective glasses in the laboratory.
Protective glasses must be worn by anyone entering the laboratory.
questions.explanation: ‘cannot … without’ = zorunluluk (must be worn).

questions.stem: The new medicine is more effective than the old one.
options: The new medicine is not as effective as the old one.
The old medicine is as effective as the new one.
The old medicine is less effective than the new one.
The new medicine is more expensive than the old one.
questions.explanation: Karşılaştırmanın yönü çevrildiğinde ‘less … than’ kullanılır.

questions.stem: It rarely snows in this part of the country.
options: Snow is uncommon in this region of the country.
People in this region rarely see the sea.
It snows almost every winter in this region.
Snow is the main problem in this region.
It never snows in this part of the country.
questions.explanation: ‘rarely’ = ‘uncommon’; ‘never’ fazla kesindir.

questions.stem: The museum is so popular that you have to book tickets weeks in advance.
options: The museum is popular, but tickets can be bought at the door.
Because the museum attracts so many visitors, tickets must be reserved weeks ahead.
The museum sells tickets only a few weeks before it opens.
Tickets are expensive, so the museum is not very popular.
You can visit the museum without booking because it is popular.
questions.explanation: ‘so … that’ neden-sonuç ilişkisi korunmalı.

questions.stem: Despite the heavy rain, the match went ahead as planned.
options: The match was planned for a rainy day.
The heavy rain started after the match had finished.
The match was cancelled even though it did not rain.
Although it was raining heavily, the match was played as scheduled.
Because of the heavy rain, the match was postponed.
questions.explanation: ‘Despite’ = ‘Although’; maç oynandı.

questions.stem: Only a few students passed the final exam.
options: None of the students passed the final exam.
Only a few students took the final exam.
Most of the students failed the final exam.
The final exam was very easy for the students.
A lot of students passed the final exam easily.
questions.explanation: ‘Only a few passed’ = ‘most failed’.

questions.stem: Children learn languages more easily than adults do.
options: Adults do not learn languages at all.
Adults and children learn languages equally easily.
Children learn more languages than adults.
Adults find it harder to learn languages than children.
Children find it harder to learn languages than adults.
questions.explanation: Yön çevrildiğinde ‘adults find it harder’.

questions.stem: The bridge was built in only eighteen months.
options: Building the bridge took longer than planned.
The bridge took eighteen years to build.
The bridge has been open for eighteen months.
The bridge will be completed in eighteen months.
It took just a year and a half to construct the bridge.
questions.explanation: 18 ay = bir buçuk yıl; ‘only’ = ‘just’.

questions.stem: The company will not hire new staff unless its profits increase.
options: New staff will be hired only if the company’s profits go up.
The company’s profits increased because it hired new staff.
The company has stopped hiring because its profits are high.
The company will hire new staff even if its profits fall.
The company will hire new staff whether its profits increase or not.
questions.explanation: ‘not … unless’ = ‘only if’.

questions.stem: Walking is one of the simplest ways to stay healthy.
options: Walking is the only way to stay healthy.
Staying healthy is not simple without walking.
Walking is harmful for most people.
Walking is less healthy than other forms of exercise.
Walking is among the easiest ways of keeping fit.
questions.explanation: ‘one of the simplest’ = ‘among the easiest’; ‘the only’ kapsamı değiştirir.

questions.stem: The train arrived an hour later than expected.
options: The train left an hour late but arrived on time.
The train was expected to be an hour late.
The train was one hour late.
The train arrived an hour early.
The train journey took one hour.
questions.explanation: ‘later than expected’ = ‘late’.

questions.stem: Nobody in the class knew the answer except Deniz.
options: Deniz asked the class for the answer.
No student in the class knew the answer.
Deniz did not know the answer, but everyone else did.
Deniz was the only student in the class who knew the answer.
Everyone in the class, including Deniz, knew the answer.
questions.explanation: ‘Nobody … except Deniz’ = ‘Deniz was the only one’.

questions.stem: The shop is closed on Sundays.
options: The shop is open every day of the week.
The shop closes early on Sundays.
The shop does not open on Sundays.
The shop is only open on Sundays.
questions.explanation: ‘closed on Sundays’ = ‘does not open on Sundays’ (genel durum).

questions.stem: Had it not been for the quick response of the fire brigade, the whole building would have burnt down.
options: The fire brigade’s rapid action prevented the entire building from being destroyed by fire.
The fire brigade arrived quickly, but the building still burnt down.
The building was destroyed before the fire brigade could respond.
The whole building burnt down because the fire brigade responded slowly.
If the fire brigade responds quickly, buildings will not burn down.
questions.explanation: Type 3 gerçek dışılık: hızlı müdahale oldu → bina kurtuldu.

questions.stem: Contrary to what many people think, spiders are not insects.
options: Although many people believe otherwise, spiders do not belong to the insect group.
Most people know that spiders are not insects.
Spiders are the most common insects, as many people think.
Many people think spiders are insects, and they are right.
Spiders are insects, contrary to what scientists believe.
questions.explanation: ‘Contrary to what many think’ = ‘although many believe otherwise’.

questions.stem: The more time students spend on social media, the less they tend to sleep.
options: Students who sleep less spend less time on social media.
Students never use social media before going to sleep.
Students sleep more when they use social media more.
Social media helps students to sleep better.
Students who use social media for longer periods generally get less sleep.
questions.explanation: Orantı ilişkisi: sosyal medya ↑ → uyku ↓; ‘tend to’ = ‘generally’.

questions.stem: It is widely believed that the painting was completed in the early sixteenth century.
options: Few experts believe that the painting is from the sixteenth century.
The painting was started in the early sixteenth century but never finished.
Many people think that the painting was finished in the early 1500s.
It has been proven that the painting was finished in the 1600s.
It is uncertain whether the painting was ever completed.
questions.explanation: ‘widely believed’ = ‘many people think’; 16. yüzyıl başı = early 1500s.

questions.stem: Not until the results were published did the public become aware of the problem.
options: The results were never published, so the public never learnt about the problem.
The public ignored the problem even after the results were published.
The results were published because the public was worried about the problem.
The public was aware of the problem before the results were published.
The public only learnt about the problem after the results had been published.
questions.explanation: ‘Not until … did’ = ‘only … after’.

questions.stem: The factory closed down, which led to a sharp rise in local unemployment.
options: Unemployment in the area fell after the factory closed.
The factory closed because unemployment in the area was high.
The closure of the factory caused unemployment in the area to increase dramatically.
Although the factory closed, local unemployment did not change.
The factory employed most of the unemployed people in the area.
questions.explanation: Neden (kapanış) → sonuç (işsizlikte keskin artış).

questions.stem: Few scientists doubt that human activity is the main cause of global warming.
options: Few scientists have studied the causes of global warming.
Most scientists agree that global warming is mainly caused by human activity.
Human activity is one of many minor causes of global warming.
Many scientists doubt that humans cause global warming.
Scientists have proven that human activity is the only cause of global warming.
questions.explanation: ‘Few doubt’ = ‘most agree’; ‘main cause’ ≠ ‘only cause’.

questions.stem: The medicine can only be effective if it is taken regularly.
options: The medicine is effective even when it is taken irregularly.
The medicine should be taken only once.
Regular use is a condition for the medicine to work.
The medicine is more effective if taken occasionally.
Taking the medicine regularly may cause side effects.
questions.explanation: ‘only … if’ = gerekli koşul.

questions.stem: Although the author is best known for her novels, she also wrote several successful plays.
options: The author is famous for her plays rather than her novels.
The author wrote only novels, not plays.
The author’s plays were less successful than her novels.
The author wrote a number of successful plays as well, even though she is famous mainly for her novels.
The author stopped writing novels in order to write plays.
questions.explanation: ‘best known for novels’ + ‘also plays’ bilgisi korunmalı.

questions.stem: The number of visitors to the park has doubled since the new entrance was opened.
options: The park had twice as many visitors before the new entrance was built.
Twice as many people have visited the park since the new entrance opened.
Half as many people visit the park now as before.
The new entrance was opened because the number of visitors doubled.
The number of visitors will double when the new entrance opens.
questions.explanation: ‘doubled since’ = ‘twice as many since’.

questions.stem: It is not necessary to have any previous experience to apply for the course.
options: Only experienced people can apply for the course.
Applicants do not need to have any prior experience for the course.
Previous experience is an advantage for the course.
Applicants must not have any previous experience.
The course gives applicants a lot of experience.
questions.explanation: ‘not necessary’ = ‘do not need to’; ‘must not’ yasak anlamı verir.

questions.stem: Scientists are unlikely to find a cure for the disease in the near future.
options: A cure for the disease will never be found.
Scientists will certainly find a cure for the disease soon.
Scientists have already found a cure for the disease.
Scientists do not want to find a cure for the disease.
It is improbable that a cure for the disease will be discovered soon.
questions.explanation: ‘unlikely’ = ‘improbable’; ‘never’ fazla kesin.

questions.stem: The festival attracts more visitors each year than the city has residents.
options: The city has more residents than the festival has visitors.
The festival is popular only among the city’s residents.
Every year, the number of people who come to the festival is greater than the city’s population.
The festival’s visitors decide to live in the city.
Most of the festival’s visitors are residents of the city.
questions.explanation: Karşılaştırma: ziyaretçi sayısı > nüfus.

questions.stem: Unlike his brother, who prefers city life, Kemal enjoys living in the countryside.
options: Kemal’s brother enjoys the countryside more than Kemal does.
Kemal likes rural life, whereas his brother would rather live in a city.
Both Kemal and his brother enjoy living in the countryside.
Kemal and his brother both prefer city life.
Kemal moved to the countryside because his brother lives in the city.
questions.explanation: ‘Unlike’ karşıtlığı ‘whereas’ ile korunur.

questions.stem: Far from reducing costs, the new system has actually made production more expensive.
options: The new system has reduced production costs considerably.
The new system will reduce costs, although it is expensive to install.
The new system was introduced because production had become more expensive.
Production costs have remained the same since the new system was introduced.
Instead of lowering costs as expected, the new system has increased the cost of production.
questions.explanation: ‘Far from reducing’ = ‘instead of lowering’; sonuç: maliyet arttı.

questions.stem: Only when the full effects of the treatment are understood will it be approved for general use.
options: Understanding the treatment’s effects is not necessary for its approval.
The full effects of the treatment will be understood after it is approved.
The treatment has been approved, although its effects are not fully understood.
The treatment will never be approved because its effects are unknown.
The treatment will not be approved for general use until its full effects are understood.
questions.explanation: ‘Only when … will …’ = ‘not … until …’.

questions.stem: The survey suggests that people are becoming increasingly reluctant to share personal data online.
options: According to the survey, a growing number of people are unwilling to give their personal information on the internet.
People have always refused to share their personal data online.
The survey proves that people are happy to share their personal data online.
The survey suggests that people no longer use the internet.
Sharing personal data online has become easier, according to the survey.
questions.explanation: ‘increasingly reluctant’ = ‘growing number … unwilling’; ‘suggests’ temkinli.

questions.stem: There is little evidence to support the claim that the new diet improves memory.
options: The new diet has been shown to damage memory.
The new diet improves memory, but only slightly.
No one has ever studied the effects of the new diet on memory.
The idea that the new diet has a positive effect on memory is not well supported by evidence.
There is strong evidence that the new diet improves memory.
questions.explanation: ‘little evidence’ = ‘not well supported’; kanıt azlığı ≠ zarar kanıtı.

questions.stem: So complex is the human brain that scientists still understand only a fraction of how it works.
options: The human brain is simpler than scientists once believed.
The human brain is so complicated that researchers have so far grasped just a small part of its functioning.
Only a few scientists study how the human brain works.
Scientists understand the human brain completely, despite its complexity.
Scientists have stopped studying the brain because it is too complex.
questions.explanation: Devrik ‘So complex … that’ neden-sonuç; ‘a fraction’ = ‘a small part’.

questions.stem: The decline in bird populations cannot be attributed solely to habitat loss.
options: Habitat loss is not the only factor behind the fall in bird numbers.
Birds lose their habitats because their populations decline.
Bird populations are increasing despite habitat loss.
Habitat loss is the only reason why bird populations are declining.
Habitat loss has no effect on bird populations.
questions.explanation: ‘not … solely’ = ‘not the only factor’; habitat kaybı yine bir etkendir.

questions.stem: Had the negotiations failed, the two countries might well have gone to war.
options: The success of the negotiations may have prevented a war between the two countries.
The negotiations failed, but war was avoided.
If negotiations fail, the two countries will certainly go to war.
The two countries went to war because the negotiations failed.
The two countries went to war before the negotiations began.
questions.explanation: Type 3 gerçek dışı: görüşmeler başarılı oldu → savaş muhtemelen önlendi; ‘might well’ = olasılık.

questions.stem: It was not so much the cost as the time involved that made the project unattractive.
options: Both the cost and the time made the project equally unattractive.
The project took a long time because it was very expensive.
The high cost of the project was the main reason it was rejected.
The main reason the project seemed unappealing was the time it would take rather than its cost.
The project was attractive because it was cheap and quick.
questions.explanation: ‘not so much X as Y’ = ‘Y rather than X’.

questions.stem: The theory, once dismissed as fantasy, is now accepted by most physicists.
options: Most physicists now accept the theory, although it was previously regarded as unrealistic.
Physicists have never taken the theory seriously.
The theory became a popular fantasy novel.
The theory was accepted in the past but has now been rejected.
Most physicists still regard the theory as pure fantasy.
questions.explanation: Geçmişte reddedildi → şimdi kabul görüyor; zaman yönü korunmalı.

questions.stem: Much as she admired the architect’s work, she felt the building was too large for the site.
options: She admired the building because it was large.
She thought the site was too large for such a small building.
She disliked the architect’s work because the building was too large.
The architect agreed that the building was too large for the site.
Although she had great respect for the architect’s designs, she thought the building was out of proportion to its location.
questions.explanation: ‘Much as’ = ‘although’; hayranlık + eleştiri birlikte korunmalı.

questions.stem: In no other country has the population aged as rapidly as in Japan.
options: The population of Japan is younger than that of other countries.
Japan’s population has aged faster than that of any other country.
Japan has the largest population in the world.
Japan’s population is ageing more slowly than in other countries.
Many countries have populations that age as fast as Japan’s.
questions.explanation: Devrik olumsuz karşılaştırma = üstünlük: en hızlı Japonya’da.

questions.stem: The findings, while interesting, are too limited to justify any firm conclusions.
options: The findings will become more interesting when conclusions are drawn.
Although the results are of interest, they are not extensive enough to support definite conclusions.
The findings are so interesting that firm conclusions can be drawn.
Firm conclusions were drawn from the limited findings.
The findings are neither interesting nor useful.
questions.explanation: ‘while interesting’ = ‘although of interest’; ‘too limited to justify’ = ‘not extensive enough to support’.

questions.stem: Hardly had the government introduced the new tax when protests broke out across the country.
options: Protests started all over the country almost as soon as the new tax was introduced.
The protests forced the government to introduce a new tax.
There were hardly any protests against the new tax.
The government introduced the new tax after the protests had ended.
The government cancelled the new tax because of the protests.
questions.explanation: ‘Hardly had … when’ = ‘as soon as’.

questions.stem: The results of the two studies, though obtained by different methods, point in the same direction.
options: Despite using different approaches, both studies produced results that support the same conclusion.
The two studies were carried out by the same research team.
The two studies used different methods, so their results contradict each other.
The two studies used the same methods but reached opposite conclusions.
Only one of the studies produced reliable results.
questions.explanation: ‘though obtained by different methods’ + ‘point in the same direction’ birlikte korunmalı.

questions.stem: Were it not for tourism, the island’s economy would collapse.
options: The island’s economy collapsed before tourism began.
Tourism has caused the island’s economy to collapse.
Tourism plays only a small part in the island’s economy.
The island’s economy depends on tourism to survive.
The island’s economy would be stronger without tourism.
questions.explanation: Type 2 gerçek dışı: turizm olmasaydı ekonomi çökerdi → ekonomi turizme bağlı.

questions.stem: The museum is open every day except Monday.
options: The museum is closed every day.
The museum is closed only on Mondays.
The museum was closed last Monday.
The museum opens late on Mondays.
The museum is open only on Mondays.
questions.explanation: ‘every day except Monday’ = yalnızca pazartesi kapalı.

questions.stem: She started learning Spanish three years ago.
options: She learnt Spanish in three months.
She will start learning Spanish in three years.
She has been learning Spanish for three years.
She stopped learning Spanish three years ago.
questions.explanation: ‘started … three years ago’ = ‘has been learning … for three years’.

questions.stem: The price of the house was too high for the young couple to afford.
options: The young couple could not afford the house because it was so expensive.
The couple thought the house was too small.
The young couple bought the house because it was cheap.
The house was expensive, but the couple bought it anyway.
The couple sold their house for a high price.
questions.explanation: ‘too high … to afford’ = alamadılar.

questions.stem: It is unlikely that the project will be completed on time.
options: The project will certainly be finished early.
Nobody knows when the project started.
The project will probably not be finished by the deadline.
The project was completed on time.
The project will never be completed.
questions.explanation: ‘unlikely’ = ‘probably not’; ‘never’ kesinlik ekler.

questions.stem: Scarcely had the ceremony begun when the power went out.
options: The power went out before the ceremony was planned.
There was scarcely any power during the ceremony.
The power failed almost immediately after the ceremony started.
The ceremony was cancelled because there was no power.
The ceremony began after the power had been restored.
questions.explanation: ‘Scarcely had … when’ = ‘hemen ardından’.

questions.stem: The study’s conclusions, however interesting, rest on a very small number of participants.
options: The study had so many participants that its conclusions are reliable.
Few people were interested in the study.
The study was interesting because it had many participants.
Although the findings are interesting, they are based on only a few participants.
The conclusions are not interesting because there were few participants.
questions.explanation: ‘however interesting’ = ‘although interesting’; ‘rest on a small number’ = ‘based on few’.

questions.stem: Without the help of volunteers, the festival could not take place.
options: The festival takes place without any volunteers.
The festival depends on volunteers in order to be held.
The festival was cancelled because volunteers came.
Volunteers organise the festival only in some years.
Volunteers prevent the festival from taking place.
questions.explanation: ‘Without … could not’ = gönüllülere bağlı.

questions.stem: Although the city spent millions on new bicycle lanes, ----.
options: most residents still prefer to travel by car
cycling has become much safer since then
more people bought bicycles last year
the lanes were built along the main roads
the project was funded by the central government
questions.explanation: ‘Although’ beklentinin tersini ister: yatırıma rağmen insanlar hâlâ araba kullanıyor.

questions.stem: Because the bridge was badly damaged in the storm, ----.
options: engineers have always admired its design
it was closed to traffic for several weeks
it connects the two halves of the city
thousands of tourists visit it every year
it is one of the oldest bridges in the country
questions.explanation: ‘Because’ sonucu ister: hasar → trafiğe kapatıldı.

questions.stem: If children read regularly from an early age, ----.
options: they had better results at school
they usually develop a richer vocabulary
libraries were built in every town
questions.explanation: Type 1/Zero koşul: If + V1 → sonuç geniş zaman (usually develop).

distractor_rationales.2: were built: zaman ve mantık uyumsuz

questions.stem: ----, the museum will be closed to visitors until next spring.
options: Unless it is reopened next spring
Although it attracts many tourists every year
Since the tickets are quite cheap
As the building is being renovated
Because it was founded in the nineteenth century
questions.explanation: Kapanmanın nedeni: bina yenileniyor.

questions.stem: Many animals sleep during the winter ----.
options: although the weather is very cold
because they have been awake all summer
so that they can save energy when food is scarce
questions.explanation: Kış uykusunun amacı: yiyecek azken enerji korumak (so that).

questions.stem: Once the students had finished the exam, ----.
options: they will study for the next one
the exam starts at nine o’clock
they are waiting for the results
they handed in their papers and left the room
the teacher has prepared the questions
questions.explanation: ‘Once + had V3’ geçmiş sıralama → Simple Past sonuç.

distractor_rationales.4: has prepared: mantık ve zaman uyumsuz

questions.stem: While some people enjoy working from home, ----.
options: they save time by not commuting
others miss the social contact of the office
the number of remote workers is increasing
questions.explanation: ‘While’ burada karşılaştırma/zıtlık: bazıları seviyor, diğerleri özlüyor.

questions.stem: The experiment failed ----.
options: even though it had been carefully planned
so that the results were published
because the samples had been contaminated
although the samples had been contaminated
questions.explanation: Başarısızlığın nedeni: örnekler kirlenmişti.

distractor_rationales.0: Zıtlık mantıksız: planlı olması başarısızlığın nedeni değil

questions.stem: Even though she had lived in Paris for ten years, ----.
options: she still could not speak French fluently
she knew the city very well
she worked at a French company
questions.explanation: ‘Even though’ beklenmedik sonuç: on yıl yaşamasına rağmen akıcı konuşamıyor.

questions.stem: The company introduced flexible working hours ----.
options: since the employees had complained about it
in order to improve the well-being of its employees
questions.explanation: Uygulamanın amacı: çalışan refahı (in order to).

distractor_rationales.0: Mantık belirsiz; ‘it’ neyi gösterdiği belli değil

questions.stem: Unless the patient follows the doctor’s advice, ----.
options: his condition is likely to get worse
questions.explanation: Unless (= if not) + Type 1 sonuç: durum kötüleşebilir.

questions.stem: The streets were empty ----.
options: as everyone was watching the final match on television
so that people could stay at home
though it was a warm summer evening
questions.explanation: Sokakların boş olmasının nedeni: herkes maç izliyordu.

questions.stem: Before the invention of the printing press, ----.
options: books are cheap and widely available
people have read newspapers every day
books had to be copied by hand
most people can read and write
libraries will be full of printed books
questions.explanation: Matbaadan önceki durum → geçmiş zaman: el ile kopyalanmak zorundaydı.

questions.stem: As the population of the city grew, ----.
options: the demand for housing increased rapidly
the city was founded by traders
it had been a small village
questions.explanation: ‘As’ burada ‘-dıkça’: nüfus arttıkça konut talebi arttı.

questions.stem: Although the task seemed simple at first, ----.
options: we completed it without any help
it turned out to be far more difficult than expected
it was very easy to complete
everyone finished it in a few minutes
questions.explanation: Başta basit görünse de → zor çıktı (zıtlık).

questions.stem: Since the new law came into force, ----.
options: the number of road accidents has fallen significantly
the law was discussed for years
questions.explanation: ‘Since + V2’ → ana cümle Present Perfect.

questions.stem: Whereas earlier studies focused mainly on the genetic causes of obesity, ----.
options: these studies were carried out on large groups
genes play a significant role in determining body weight
recent research has paid more attention to environmental factors
many people are trying to lose weight
obesity has become a global health problem
questions.explanation: ‘Whereas’ iki odağı karşılaştırır: genetik ↔ çevresel etkenler.

questions.stem: The treatment has proved effective in laboratory tests; ----.
options: for example, many patients refused it
therefore, it has been used on animals for years
however, it has not yet been tested on human patients
as a result, the disease was discovered
questions.explanation: Olumlu sonuç sonrası sınırlama → however.

questions.stem: Had the engineers taken the soil conditions into account, ----.
options: the soil is suitable for construction
the building would not have started to sink
the building will be completed on time
the building started to sink immediately
they will choose a different location
questions.explanation: Devrik Type 3 → would have V3.

questions.stem: So many species have become extinct in the last century ----.
options: in order that we can protect them
which is a serious problem for all of us
because the climate is changing rapidly
that scientists speak of a sixth mass extinction
questions.explanation: ‘So many … that’ sonuç kalıbı.

questions.stem: The survey results should be treated with caution ----.
options: so that more people can participate in the future
as they have been published widely
since only a small number of people took part in it
even though the sample was very large
questions.explanation: Temkin gerekçesi: katılımcı sayısı az.

questions.stem: Not only do bees produce honey, ----.
options: because honey is a healthy food
although some people are allergic to them
so they are kept by farmers all over the world
and honey was used as medicine
but they also pollinate a large share of the world’s crops
questions.explanation: ‘Not only … but also’ paralel yapısı.

questions.stem: Provided that the weather remains stable, ----.
options: the rocket will be launched on Tuesday morning
the launch would have been successful
the rocket was launched last week
the weather is usually stable in July
questions.explanation: ‘Provided that’ Type 1 koşul → will.

questions.stem: Just as the invention of writing changed the way knowledge was stored, ----.
options: many ancient texts have been lost
the first books were very expensive
the internet has transformed how information is shared
questions.explanation: ‘Just as …, (so) …’ benzetme kurar: yazı ↔ internet.

questions.stem: ----, the region has become one of the country’s most popular tourist destinations.
options: Despite its unspoilt beaches and mild climate
Thanks to its unspoilt beaches and mild climate
In spite of the new airport
questions.explanation: Popülerliğin nedeni → Thanks to.

questions.stem: Scientists warn that ----, the glacier could disappear completely within fifty years.
options: although it has existed for thousands of years
whether the climate changes or not
as it has been melting slowly
questions.explanation: Uyarı bir koşula dayanır: mevcut ısınma sürerse.

distractor_rationales.4: Yavaş erime ‘could disappear’ uyarısını koşul olarak kurmaz

questions.stem: Rather than punishing students for their mistakes, ----.
options: teachers are paid more in private schools
mistakes are common in language learning
good teachers use them as opportunities for learning
questions.explanation: ‘Rather than’ iki eylemi karşılaştırır; özne aynı olmalı (teachers).

questions.stem: The ancient Egyptians preserved the bodies of their dead ----.
options: although they had no written language
because they believed the body was needed in the afterlife
even if they were very expensive
so that archaeologists could study them
questions.explanation: Mumyalamanın nedeni: öbür dünya inancı.

questions.stem: It was only after the company lost several major clients ----.
options: that it began to take customer complaints seriously
when it has changed its strategy
so it will improve its service
which it had never experienced before
questions.explanation: ‘It was only after … that …’ vurgu kalıbı.

questions.stem: Even if the new vaccine proves successful, ----.
options: it was more effective than expected
it will take years to produce enough doses for everyone
it would have saved many lives
it had been tested on thousands of volunteers
questions.explanation: ‘Even if’ Type 1: başarılı olsa bile → yine de yıllar sürecek.

questions.stem: In contrast to its neighbours, which rely heavily on imported energy, ----.
options: the region has few natural resources
energy prices have risen across the region
renewable energy is becoming more popular
the country produces most of its electricity from its own rivers
questions.explanation: Karşıtlık: komşular ithalata bağlı ↔ ülke kendi kaynaklarından üretiyor.

questions.stem: The longer a person goes without sleep, ----.
options: the more difficult it becomes to concentrate
many adults sleep less than seven hours
people who sleep less are tired
questions.explanation: ‘The longer …, the more …’ paralel karşılaştırma.

questions.stem: Much as the government would like to cut taxes, ----.
options: taxes were last cut five years ago
the current budget deficit makes such a move impossible
the opposition has also promised tax cuts
questions.explanation: ‘Much as’ (ne kadar istese de) ödün: isteğe rağmen bütçe açığı engel.

questions.stem: Whatever the long-term effects of the policy may turn out to be, ----.
options: its immediate impact on unemployment has clearly been positive
the long-term effects are still unknown
the policy was introduced two years ago
economists disagree about its long-term effects
it will be reviewed by parliament
questions.explanation: ‘Whatever … may be’ sonrası kesin bir şeyi vurgular: kısa vadeli etki olumlu.

questions.stem: Though often dismissed as mere folklore, ----.
options: many people believe in traditional remedies
folklore is passed on orally from generation to generation
some traditional remedies have been shown to contain effective compounds
questions.explanation: Kısaltılmış ‘though’ cümlesi: öznesi ana cümlenin öznesi (remedies) olmalı ve zıtlık kurmalı.

questions.stem: Were it not for the protective layer of ozone in the upper atmosphere, ----.
options: life on Earth would be exposed to harmful levels of ultraviolet radiation
scientists discovered the ozone hole in 1985
life will adapt to the conditions
the ozone layer was damaged by chemicals
questions.explanation: ‘Were it not for’ = if it were not for (Type 2) → would + V1.

questions.stem: The findings are all the more remarkable ----.
options: unless they are confirmed by further studies
so that other researchers can use them
given that the study was conducted with very limited funding
which was published in a leading journal
questions.explanation: ‘all the more remarkable given that’: dikkat çekiciliği artıran gerekçe.

questions.stem: Insofar as the evidence allows us to judge, ----.
options: historians have always been interested in the topic
the evidence was collected by several teams
the decline of the civilisation was gradual rather than sudden
questions.explanation: ‘Insofar as’ (… ölçüde) bir yargıyı sınırlar: kanıtın izin verdiği ölçüde çöküş kademeliydi.

questions.stem: Critics of the plan argue that, far from reducing traffic, ----.
options: traffic is a major problem in the city
the new motorway will simply encourage more people to drive
the motorway was completed last year
the plan will cut journey times significantly
questions.explanation: ‘far from reducing’ tam tersi etkiyi ister: daha fazla araç trafiği.

questions.stem: The artist’s early works received little attention during her lifetime, ----.
options: whereas today they are sold for millions at auction
so she worked in a small studio
questions.explanation: Ömründeki ilgisizlik ↔ bugünkü değer karşıtlığı.

questions.stem: Lest the rare manuscripts be damaged by light, ----.
options: they were written on fragile paper
they are displayed in dimly lit rooms and rotated regularly
the library was built in the Middle Ages
questions.explanation: ‘Lest’ (… olmasın diye) önlem ister.

questions.stem: Given how little is known about the deep ocean, ----.
options: the deep ocean is very dark and cold
deep-sea exploration began in the nineteenth century
it is hardly surprising that new species are discovered there every year
the ocean covers more than seventy percent of the planet
scientists have mapped the entire seabed
questions.explanation: ‘Given …’ gerekçe: az bilindiği için yeni türlerin bulunması şaşırtıcı değil.

questions.stem: No matter how carefully the experiment is designed, ----.
options: some degree of measurement error is unavoidable
the experiment has been carefully designed
questions.explanation: ‘No matter how’ (ne kadar … olursa olsun) + kaçınılmaz sonuç.

questions.stem: Only when the full costs of pollution are included in the price of goods ----.
options: the price of goods has risen
will consumers have a real incentive to choose cleaner products
pollution was reduced in many countries
questions.explanation: ‘Only when …’ ile başlayan cümlede ana cümle devrik: will + özne.

questions.stem: The drug may have unpleasant side effects; ----, for many patients the benefits clearly outweigh the risks.
questions.explanation: Olumsuz bilgiden sonra buna rağmen olumlu yargı → nevertheless.

questions.stem: Inasmuch as the new rules apply to all member states equally, ----.
options: no country can claim that it is being treated unfairly
the rules were written in Brussels
questions.explanation: ‘Inasmuch as’ (-dığı için) gerekçe → hiçbir ülke haksızlığa uğradığını iddia edemez.

questions.stem: Had it not been for the invention of refrigeration, ----.
options: refrigerators are found in most homes
modern cities could hardly have grown to their present size
questions.explanation: Devrik Type 3 → could have V3.

questions.stem: Whether the ancient structure was a temple or an astronomical observatory, ----.
options: the structure is made of stone
astronomy was important for ancient people
it clearly required remarkable engineering skills to build
questions.explanation: ‘Whether … or …’ iki olasılıktan bağımsız kesin bir yargı ister.

questions.stem: If you want to improve your English, ----.
options: English was spoken in many countries
the course had started in September
you studied very hard last year
you would have passed the exam
you should try to read something in English every day
questions.explanation: Type 1 koşul ve tavsiye: should + V1.

questions.stem: The children were so tired after the trip ----.
options: that they fell asleep as soon as they got home
although they enjoyed it a lot
because they had walked all day
unless they went to bed early
questions.explanation: ‘so … that’ sonuç kalıbı.

questions.stem: Although the new phone has an impressive camera, ----.
options: its battery life is disappointing compared with older models
phone cameras have improved a lot
many people buy it for taking photos
it was launched in more than fifty countries
the camera can take pictures at night
questions.explanation: Olumlu özelliğe karşı olumsuz yargı → zıtlık.

questions.stem: Scientists are studying the Arctic ice closely ----.
options: because its melting could affect weather patterns across the world
so the ice has become thicker
even though the Arctic is very cold
questions.explanation: Yakından incelemenin nedeni: erimenin küresel etkisi.

questions.stem: ----, the ancient city was rediscovered only in the nineteenth century.
options: Although archaeologists had never searched for it
If it had been built near the sea
Having been buried under sand for centuries
Since tourists visit it every year
Because it was famous in the ancient world
questions.explanation: Kısaltılmış neden cümlesi: yüzyıllarca kum altında kaldığı için geç keşfedildi.

questions.stem: Unlike earlier theories, which treated language as a purely learned skill, ----.
options: modern linguistics suggests that humans have an innate capacity for language
children learn language by imitating their parents
language was studied mainly by philosophers
questions.explanation: ‘Unlike earlier theories …’ karşıt bir yaklaşım ister: doğuştan yetenek.

questions.stem: So long as the ice sheets continue to melt at the current rate, ----.
options: sea levels rose sharply in the last century
scientists would have predicted the change
sea levels will keep rising well into the next century
the ice sheets had been stable for thousands of years
the melting was first recorded in the 1970s
questions.explanation: ‘So long as’ (… sürece) Type 1 koşul → will.

questions.stem: The evidence, ----, strongly suggests that the settlement was abandoned suddenly.
questions.explanation: ‘sıfat + as + özne + fiil’ ödün yapısı: eksik olsa da.

distractor_rationales.1: Söz dizimi bozuk (however incomplete it is olmalı)

questions.stem: Düzenli uyku, hafızayı güçlendirmeye yardımcı olur.
options: Regular sleep helps to strengthen memory.
People with a strong memory sleep regularly.
Memory helps people to sleep regularly.
Sleeping regularly is the only way to strengthen memory.
questions.explanation: Özne ‘düzenli uyku’, yüklem ‘yardımcı olur’ (helps).

questions.stem: Yeni kütüphane gelecek yıl açılacak.
options: The new library has been open for a year.
The library will be renovated next year.
The new library will be opened next year.
A new library should be opened next year.
The new library was opened last year.
questions.explanation: Gelecek zaman edilgen → will be opened.

questions.stem: Pek çok öğrenci matematikte zorlanıyor.
options: Many students used to have difficulty with mathematics.
Mathematics is the most difficult subject for students.
Many students have difficulty with mathematics.
Few students have difficulty with mathematics.
questions.explanation: ‘Pek çok’ = many; şimdiki durum.

questions.stem: Hava çok soğuk olduğu için okullar kapatıldı.
options: The schools are always closed in cold weather.
Although the weather was very cold, the schools were not closed.
The weather became cold after the schools were closed.
The schools will be closed if the weather is cold.
The schools were closed because the weather was very cold.
questions.explanation: Neden (-dığı için → because) ve geçmiş edilgen (were closed).

questions.stem: Bu ilaç yalnızca doktor reçetesiyle satılabilir.
options: This medicine can be sold without a prescription.
This medicine can only be sold with a doctor’s prescription.
This medicine is sold in every pharmacy.
This medicine must be sold by doctors.
questions.explanation: ‘yalnızca … satılabilir’ → can only be sold.

questions.stem: Deniz seviyesi her yıl birkaç milimetre yükseliyor.
options: Sea levels are rising by a few millimetres every year.
Sea levels are falling slowly every year.
Sea levels rose by a few metres last year.
Sea levels will stop rising in a few years.
Sea levels have risen by a few millimetres in total.
questions.explanation: Süregelen durum + ‘her yıl’ → are rising … every year.

questions.stem: Bilim insanları bu türün nasıl hayatta kaldığını hâlâ bilmiyor.
options: Scientists still do not know how this species survives.
This species survives because scientists protect it.
Scientists want to know why this species became extinct.
Nobody will ever know how this species survives.
Scientists have discovered how this species survives.
questions.explanation: ‘hâlâ bilmiyor’ = still do not know; isim cümleciği ‘how … survives’.

questions.stem: Eğer erken çıkarsak trafiğe yakalanmayız.
options: If we leave early, we will not get stuck in traffic.
If we had left early, we would not have got stuck in traffic.
We always leave early to avoid traffic.
We got stuck in traffic because we left early.
Even if we leave early, we will get stuck in traffic.
questions.explanation: Type 1 koşul → If + V1, will not …

questions.stem: Müze, şehrin en eski binasında bulunuyor.
options: The museum was built next to the oldest building in the city.
The museum is the oldest building in the city.
The oldest building in the city will become a museum.
The museum is located in one of the newest buildings in the city.
The museum is located in the oldest building in the city.
questions.explanation: ‘-de bulunuyor’ = is located in; üstünlük (en eski) korunmalı.

questions.stem: Çocukların çoğu sebze yemeyi sevmez.
options: Most children do not like eating vegetables.
questions.explanation: ‘çoğu’ = most; olumsuz ‘sevmez’.

questions.stem: Toplantı, yöneticinin hastalanması nedeniyle ertelendi.
options: The meeting was cancelled although the manager was ill.
The manager postponed the meeting to visit a doctor.
The manager fell ill during the meeting.
The meeting will be postponed if the manager is ill.
The meeting was postponed because the manager fell ill.
questions.explanation: Edilgen geçmiş + neden → was postponed because …

questions.stem: İnternet, bilgiye erişimi kolaylaştırdı.
options: Information is easier to find in books than on the internet.
The internet has made access to information easier.
The internet will make access to information harder.
Access to information created the internet.
The internet has made information less reliable.
questions.explanation: Geçmişten bugüne etki → has made … easier.

questions.stem: Araştırmacılar, bu bitkinin kuraklığa dayanıklı olmasının nedenini açıklamaya çalışıyor.
options: This plant is resistant to drought because researchers modified it.
Researchers are trying to explain why this plant is resistant to drought.
Researchers are trying to make this plant resistant to drought.
Researchers have explained why this plant cannot survive drought.
Researchers explain that drought is harmful to all plants.
questions.explanation: ‘açıklamaya çalışıyor’ = are trying to explain; ‘nedeni’ → why.

questions.stem: Hükümet, yeni vergi yasasının ekonomiyi canlandıracağını umuyor.
options: The government fears that the new tax law will harm the economy.
The economy will grow only if the government changes the tax law.
The new tax law was introduced because the economy was growing.
The government is sure that the new tax law has stimulated the economy.
The government hopes that the new tax law will stimulate the economy.
questions.explanation: ‘umuyor’ = hopes; gelecek ‘canlandıracağını’ → will stimulate.

questions.stem: Bu bölgede yaşayan insanların çoğu geçimini balıkçılıkla sağlıyor.
options: All the people in this region work in the fishing industry.
Most people who fish live in this region.
Most of the people living in this region earn their living from fishing.
Fishing is becoming less important in this region.
People in this region used to make a living from fishing.
questions.explanation: ‘çoğu’ = most; sıfat cümleciği ‘yaşayan’ → living in; şimdiki durum.

questions.stem: Deney, beklenenin aksine hiçbir olumlu sonuç vermedi.
options: Contrary to expectations, the experiment did not yield any positive results.
The experiment yielded some positive results despite expectations.
As expected, the experiment did not yield any positive results.
The experiment yielded more positive results than expected.
The experiment was expected to fail, and it did.
questions.explanation: ‘beklenenin aksine’ = contrary to expectations; ‘hiçbir … vermedi’ olumsuzluğu korunmalı.

questions.stem: Eski binalar, depreme dayanıklı hâle getirilmedikçe yıkılma tehlikesiyle karşı karşıya kalacak.
options: Only new buildings can be made earthquake-resistant.
Old buildings will collapse even if they are made earthquake-resistant.
Unless they are made earthquake-resistant, old buildings will face the danger of collapsing.
Old buildings collapsed because they were not earthquake-resistant.
Since old buildings have been made earthquake-resistant, they will not collapse.
questions.explanation: ‘-medikçe’ = unless; edilgen ‘getirilmedikçe’ → unless they are made.

questions.stem: Yazarın ilk romanı, yayımlandığı dönemde pek ilgi görmemişti.
options: Nobody has read the author’s first novel since it was published.
The author published his first novel because it attracted attention.
The author’s later novels attracted less attention than the first one.
The author’s first novel had attracted little attention when it was published.
The author’s first novel became a bestseller as soon as it was published.
questions.explanation: ‘pek ilgi görmemişti’ = had attracted little attention (miş’li geçmiş).

questions.stem: Uzmanlara göre çocukların ekran başında geçirdiği süre sınırlandırılmalıdır.
options: Experts have banned children from using screens.
Children who spend time in front of screens become experts.
According to experts, children do not spend enough time in front of screens.
According to experts, the time children spend in front of screens should be limited.
Experts spend a limited amount of time in front of screens.
questions.explanation: ‘sınırlandırılmalıdır’ = should be limited; sıfat cümleciği ‘çocukların geçirdiği süre’.

questions.stem: Nüfus arttıkça doğal kaynaklar üzerindeki baskı da artıyor.
options: As the population grows, the pressure on natural resources also increases.
The population is growing because natural resources are abundant.
Although the population is growing, pressure on resources is decreasing.
Natural resources increase as the population grows.
The pressure on natural resources caused the population to grow.
questions.explanation: ‘arttıkça’ = as (… -dıkça); paralel artış.

questions.stem: Bu keşif, hastalığın nasıl yayıldığına dair anlayışımızı tamamen değiştirebilir.
options: This discovery will slightly change how the disease is treated.
This discovery could completely change our understanding of how the disease spreads.
This discovery proves that the disease does not spread.
This discovery has completely changed how the disease spreads.
Our understanding of the disease led to this discovery.
questions.explanation: ‘değiştirebilir’ = could change (olasılık); ‘nasıl yayıldığına dair’ = of how … spreads.

questions.stem: Pek çok ülke, fosil yakıtlara olan bağımlılığını azaltmak için yenilenebilir enerjiye yatırım yapıyor.
options: Few countries invest in renewable energy to reduce their dependence on fossil fuels.
Many countries are investing in renewable energy in order to reduce their dependence on fossil fuels.
Renewable energy has reduced the price of fossil fuels in many countries.
Many countries depend on renewable energy because fossil fuels are expensive.
Many countries have stopped investing in fossil fuels.
questions.explanation: Amaç (… için) → in order to; ‘pek çok’ = many.

questions.stem: Toplantıya katılanların hiçbiri öneriye itiraz etmedi.
options: Nobody attended the meeting because of the proposal.
Everyone who objected to the proposal left the meeting.
Some of those who attended the meeting objected to the proposal.
None of those who attended the meeting objected to the proposal.
The proposal was rejected by everyone at the meeting.
questions.explanation: ‘hiçbiri … etmedi’ = none of … objected.

questions.stem: Uzay aracı, Mars’a ulaşmadan önce yedi ay boyunca yolculuk etti.
options: The spacecraft will travel for seven months after it reaches Mars.
The spacecraft has been travelling around Mars for seven months.
It takes seven months for any spacecraft to reach Mars.
The spacecraft travelled for seven months before it reached Mars.
The spacecraft reached Mars seven months ago.
questions.explanation: ‘ulaşmadan önce’ = before it reached; süre ‘for seven months’.

questions.stem: Bazı tarihçiler, imparatorluğun çöküşünün ekonomik nedenlerden çok iklim değişikliğinden kaynaklandığını ileri sürüyor.
options: Some historians argue that the collapse of the empire resulted from climate change rather than from economic factors.
Some historians argue that both economic factors and climate change played an equal role in the collapse.
The empire collapsed because historians ignored climate change.
Historians agree that economic factors were the main cause of the empire’s collapse.
Some historians argue that climate change was caused by the collapse of the empire.
questions.explanation: ‘-den çok … -den kaynaklandığını’ = resulted from X rather than from Y; ‘bazı’ = some.

questions.stem: İlaç, klinik denemelerde umut verici sonuçlar vermiş olsa da uzun vadeli etkileri henüz bilinmiyor.
options: The drug’s long-term effects are promising, although its clinical trial results were disappointing.
Although the drug has produced promising results in clinical trials, its long-term effects are not yet known.
Because the drug has produced promising results in clinical trials, its long-term effects are well known.
The drug produced promising results in clinical trials, so it is now widely used.
The drug will not be tested in clinical trials until its long-term effects are known.
questions.explanation: ‘-miş olsa da’ = although … has produced; ‘henüz bilinmiyor’ = are not yet known.

questions.stem: Eğer antibiyotikler bu kadar yaygın kullanılmasaydı, dirençli bakteriler bugün bu kadar büyük bir tehdit oluşturmayabilirdi.
options: Resistant bacteria pose a threat today even though antibiotics are rarely used.
If antibiotics are used widely, resistant bacteria will pose a great threat.
If antibiotics had not been used so widely, resistant bacteria might not pose such a great threat today.
Antibiotics have been used widely to reduce the threat of resistant bacteria.
Because antibiotics are not used widely, resistant bacteria are not a threat today.
questions.explanation: Karma koşul: geçmiş koşul (had not been used) + bugünkü sonuç (might not pose … today).

questions.stem: Kent nüfusunun hızla artması, yerel yönetimleri altyapıya daha fazla yatırım yapmaya zorladı.
options: Local authorities invested in infrastructure so that the urban population would grow rapidly.
Local authorities were able to invest more in infrastructure because the population decreased.
The rapid growth of the urban population has forced local authorities to invest more in infrastructure.
Investment in infrastructure caused the urban population to grow rapidly.
Despite the rapid growth of the urban population, local authorities reduced investment in infrastructure.
questions.explanation: Özne ‘nüfusun hızla artması’ → the rapid growth of …; ‘zorladı’ = has forced / forced.

questions.stem: Arkeologlar, bulunan eşyaların sanıldığından çok daha eski olabileceğini düşünüyor.
options: Archaeologists think that the objects found are newer than was assumed.
Archaeologists think that the objects found may be much older than was previously assumed.
Archaeologists are certain that the objects found are much older than assumed.
The objects found show that archaeologists are older than assumed.
Archaeologists assumed that the objects would be found in older layers.
questions.explanation: ‘olabileceğini’ = may be; ‘sanıldığından çok daha eski’ = much older than was assumed.

questions.stem: Ne kadar dikkatli olursak olalım, bazı hataların önüne geçmek mümkün değildir.
options: However careful we may be, it is impossible to prevent some mistakes.
If we are careful enough, we can prevent all mistakes.
Because we are careful, we do not make any mistakes.
Some mistakes happen because we are too careful.
Being careful is not important, since mistakes are impossible to prevent.
questions.explanation: ‘Ne kadar … olursak olalım’ = however … we may be; olumsuzluk ‘mümkün değildir’.

questions.stem: Raporda, kadınların iş gücüne katılım oranının son on yılda belirgin biçimde arttığı belirtiliyor.
options: The report states that women’s participation in the workforce will increase over the next decade.
According to the report, women’s participation in the workforce has remained stable for ten years.
The report was written by women who have participated in the workforce for a decade.
The report states that women’s participation in the workforce has increased significantly over the last decade.
The report suggests that women should participate more in the workforce.
questions.explanation: Edilgen ‘belirtiliyor’ → states; ‘son on yılda … arttığı’ → has increased … over the last decade.

questions.stem: Deneyin sonuçları, önceki çalışmalarda elde edilen bulgularla büyük ölçüde örtüşüyor.
options: The results of the experiment largely agree with the findings obtained in previous studies.
The results of the experiment are slightly different from previous studies.
Previous studies were conducted in order to confirm the experiment.
The results of the experiment completely contradict previous findings.
The experiment was repeated because previous findings were wrong.
questions.explanation: ‘büyük ölçüde örtüşüyor’ = largely agree with; ‘elde edilen bulgular’ = findings obtained.

questions.stem: Yapay zekânın sağlık alanında sunduğu fırsatlar, beraberinde ciddi etik soruları da getiriyor.
options: The opportunities that artificial intelligence offers in healthcare also bring serious ethical questions with them.
Serious ethical questions prevent artificial intelligence from being used in healthcare.
Healthcare professionals have answered all the ethical questions about artificial intelligence.
Artificial intelligence was developed to solve ethical questions in healthcare.
Artificial intelligence offers no opportunities in healthcare because of ethical questions.
questions.explanation: Özne ‘sunduğu fırsatlar’ (opportunities that AI offers); ‘beraberinde … getiriyor’ = bring … with them.

questions.stem: Kuraklık o kadar uzun sürdü ki birçok çiftçi topraklarını terk etmek zorunda kaldı.
options: Many farmers stayed on their land despite the long drought.
The drought was short, but many farmers still left their land.
The drought lasted so long that many farmers had to abandon their land.
Farmers had to abandon their land so that the drought would end.
Many farmers abandoned their land, which caused a long drought.
questions.explanation: ‘o kadar … ki’ = so … that; ‘zorunda kaldı’ = had to.

questions.stem: Politikanın başarısı, büyük ölçüde halkın ne kadar destek vereceğine bağlı olacak.
options: The success of the policy depended slightly on public opinion.
The policy will succeed regardless of public support.
The success of the policy will depend largely on how much support the public gives.
The public supports the policy because it has been largely successful.
The public will depend on the policy for support.
questions.explanation: ‘bağlı olacak’ = will depend on; ‘ne kadar destek vereceğine’ = how much support … gives.

questions.stem: Eğitim düzeyi yükseldikçe insanların sağlıklarına daha fazla özen gösterdiği gözlemlenmiştir.
options: People pay more attention to their education when their health improves.
It has been observed that education has no effect on people’s health.
It has been observed that the higher people’s level of education, the more attention they pay to their health.
It is expected that people will pay more attention to their health in the future.
People with poor health have lower levels of education.
questions.explanation: ‘… yükseldikçe … daha fazla’ = the higher …, the more …; edilgen ‘gözlemlenmiştir’ = it has been observed.

questions.stem: Bu kitap otuzdan fazla dile çevrildi.
options: This book was written in thirty different languages.
This book has been translated into more than thirty languages.
This book will be translated into thirty languages.
This book has been translated into fewer than thirty languages.
More than thirty people translated this book.
questions.explanation: Edilgen ‘çevrildi’ → has been translated; ‘otuzdan fazla’ = more than thirty.

questions.stem: Yağmur yağmasına rağmen maç ertelenmedi.
options: The rain stopped before the match was postponed.
It did not rain, so the match was played.
The match was postponed because it rained.
The match would have been postponed if it had rained.
Although it rained, the match was not postponed.
questions.explanation: ‘-masına rağmen’ = although; olumsuz edilgen ‘ertelenmedi’ = was not postponed.

questions.stem: Uzmanlar, düzenli kitap okumanın beyin sağlığını koruduğuna inanıyor.
options: Experts believe that reading books regularly protects brain health.
Reading books regularly is believed to be harmful by experts.
Experts read books regularly to protect their brain health.
Experts doubt that reading has any effect on brain health.
Experts have proven that reading books damages brain health.
questions.explanation: ‘inanıyor’ = believe; isim cümleciği ‘okumanın … koruduğuna’ → that reading … protects.

questions.stem: Deneyin sonuçları, önceki varsayımların yeniden gözden geçirilmesi gerektiğini gösteriyor.
options: The experiment was carried out to review previous results.
The results of the experiment show that previous assumptions need to be reconsidered.
Previous assumptions show that the experiment needs to be repeated.
The results of the experiment confirm previous assumptions completely.
The experiment was repeated because previous assumptions were correct.
questions.explanation: ‘gözden geçirilmesi gerektiğini’ = need to be reconsidered (edilgen gereklilik).

questions.stem: Kardeşim benden üç yaş küçük.
options: My brother and I are the same age.
My brother is three years older than me.
My brother was three years old.
My brother is three years younger than me.
questions.explanation: ‘benden … küçük’ = younger than me; fark ‘three years’.

questions.stem: Toplantının ne zaman başlayacağı henüz belli değil.
options: It is not yet clear when the meeting will start.
The meeting started earlier than expected.
The meeting will not start until everyone arrives.
Everyone knows when the meeting will start.
It was clear that the meeting had already started.
questions.explanation: İsim cümleciği ‘ne zaman başlayacağı’ → when the meeting will start; ‘henüz … değil’ = not yet.

questions.stem: Bu hastalığın erken teşhis edilmesi, tedavinin başarısını büyük ölçüde artırır.
options: Diagnosing the disease is more difficult than treating it.
The treatment of this disease is successful only if it starts late.
This disease is usually diagnosed too late for treatment to succeed.
Early diagnosis of this disease greatly increases the success of treatment.
The success of the treatment makes early diagnosis unnecessary.
questions.explanation: Özne ‘erken teşhis edilmesi’ → early diagnosis; ‘büyük ölçüde artırır’ = greatly increases.

questions.stem: Şehir ne kadar büyürse, toplu taşımaya olan ihtiyaç da o kadar artar.
options: Large cities do not need public transport.
The city grew larger because public transport improved.
As the city grows, the need for public transport decreases.
The larger the city grows, the greater the need for public transport becomes.
Public transport makes cities grow larger.
questions.explanation: ‘ne kadar … o kadar …’ = the more/larger …, the greater …

questions.stem: Otobüs her sabah saat yedide kalkar.
options: The bus never leaves before seven.
The bus left at seven o’clock yesterday morning.
The bus leaves at seven o’clock every morning.
The bus arrives at seven o’clock every evening.
The bus will leave at seven tomorrow evening.
questions.explanation: Geniş zaman ve alışkanlık: leaves … every morning.

questions.stem: Regular physical activity can ---- the risk of heart disease by keeping blood pressure and cholesterol levels under control.
questions.explanation: ‘reduce the risk’ (riski azaltmak) kalıbı; cümlenin devamı olumlu bir etki anlatıyor.

questions.stem: The museum was closed for two years so that engineers could ---- the damage caused by the earthquake.
questions.explanation: ‘so that’ amaç bildiriyor: müze hasarı onarmak (repair) için kapatıldı.

distractor_rationales.1: ignore: görmezden gelmek; kapatma amacı olamaz
distractor_rationales.0: measure: ölçmek; iki yıl kapatmayı açıklamaz

questions.stem: Many species of birds ---- to warmer regions in autumn, when food becomes scarce in the north.
questions.explanation: Kuşların sonbaharda sıcak bölgelere gitmesi ‘migrate’ (göç etmek) ile anlatılır; ‘to warmer regions’ yön bildirir.

questions.stem: The new vaccine proved highly ---- in clinical trials, protecting over ninety percent of the participants.
questions.explanation: Katılımcıların %90’ını koruması aşının etkili (effective) olduğunu gösterir.

distractor_rationales.2: ancient: çok eski; yeni aşıyla çelişir

questions.stem: Scientists have ---- a new species of frog in the rainforests of Madagascar.
questions.explanation: Doğada var olan bir türü bulmak ‘discover’ ile ifade edilir; ‘invent’ var olmayanı icat etmektir.

distractor_rationales.3: invented: icat etmek; tür icat edilmez
distractor_rationales.1: removed: ortadan kaldırmak; olumlu haber bağlamına uymaz
distractor_rationales.4: described as: ‘as’ dan sonra nitelik gelmeli; yapı bozuk

questions.stem: Because the instructions were not ----, many students answered the wrong questions in the exam.
questions.explanation: ‘Because’ neden bildiriyor: talimatlar açık (clear) olmadığı için yanlış sorular cevaplandı.

distractor_rationales.4: loud: yüksek sesli; yazılı talimata uymaz

questions.stem: The government has decided to ---- taxes on sugary drinks in an attempt to fight obesity.
questions.explanation: Obeziteyle mücadele için şekerli içeceklerde vergiyi artırmak (increase taxes) mantıklıdır.

questions.stem: It is ---- to wear a helmet while cycling, as it can prevent serious head injuries.
questions.explanation: ‘as it can prevent serious injuries’ gerekçesi kaskın gerekli (essential) olduğunu söyler.

questions.stem: The two languages are so ---- that speakers of one can easily understand the other.
questions.explanation: ‘so … that’ sonuç kalıbı: diller o kadar benzer (similar) ki birbirlerini anlıyorlar.

questions.stem: Please ---- the form carefully and return it to the reception desk before Friday.
questions.explanation: Form doldurmak ‘fill in (a form)’ phrasal verb’üyle anlatılır.

questions.stem: Farmers in the region ---- heavily on rainfall because there is no irrigation system.
questions.explanation: ‘depend on’ (bağlı olmak) + neden cümlesi: sulama sistemi olmadığı için yağmura bağımlılar.

distractor_rationales.4: focus on: odaklanmak; ‘heavily’ ile eşdizim zayıf ve anlam uymuyor

questions.stem: The film was so ---- that many people in the audience fell asleep before the end.
questions.explanation: Seyircilerin uyuyakalması filmin sıkıcı (boring) olduğunu gösterir.

distractor_rationales.3: short: kısa film sonuna kadar uyutmaz

questions.stem: Doctors ---- patients with high blood pressure to eat less salt.
questions.explanation: ‘advise sb to do sth’ (tavsiye etmek) kalıbı; ardından ‘to eat’ gelir.

distractor_rationales.0: prevent sb from doing: to ile değil from ile
distractor_rationales.2: refuse to do: kişi nesnesi almaz

questions.stem: The earthquake ---- thousands of buildings and left many families homeless.
questions.explanation: Ailelerin evsiz kalması binaların yıkıldığını (destroyed) gösterir.

questions.stem: Water ---- at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.
questions.explanation: Suyun deniz seviyesinde 100°C’de kaynadığı (boils) bilimsel bir gerçektir.

questions.stem: The company had to ---- two hundred workers after its sales fell sharply.
questions.explanation: Satışlar düşünce işçi çıkarmak ‘lay off’ ile ifade edilir.

questions.stem: Although the treatment is costly, its long-term benefits ---- outweigh the initial expense for most patients.
questions.explanation: ‘Although’ zıtlık kuruyor: maliyetli ama faydalar maliyeti fazlasıyla (far) aşıyor. ‘far outweigh’ yaygın eşdizimdir.

questions.stem: Researchers were unable to ---- the results of the original study, which raised doubts about its reliability.
questions.explanation: Bir çalışmanın sonucunu tekrar elde edememek güvenilirliği sorgulatır: ‘replicate’ (tekrarlamak).

distractor_rationales.4: eliminate: ortadan kaldırmak; güvenilirlikle ilişkisi yok

questions.stem: The report ---- the importance of early diagnosis, noting that most cancers are treatable if detected in time.
questions.explanation: Raporun erken teşhisin çoğu kanseri tedavi edilebilir kıldığını belirtmesi önemi vurguladığını (emphasises) gösterir.

questions.stem: Poor diet and lack of exercise are major factors that ---- to the rise of type 2 diabetes.
questions.explanation: ‘contribute to’ (katkıda bulunmak, yol açmak) neden-sonuç için kullanılır.

questions.stem: In many ancient societies, knowledge was ---- orally from one generation to the next.
questions.explanation: Bilginin kuşaktan kuşağa aktarılması ‘pass down’ ile ifade edilir.

questions.stem: Unlike conventional batteries, the new devices are ---- and can be recharged thousands of times.
questions.explanation: Binlerce kez şarj edilebilmek dayanıklılık (durable) anlatır; ‘Unlike’ geleneksel pillerle karşıtlık kurar.

distractor_rationales.3: obsolete: modası geçmiş; olumlu bağlamla çelişir

questions.stem: The committee will ---- the proposal carefully before making a final decision next month.
questions.explanation: Karar vermeden önce öneriyi dikkatle değerlendirmek (evaluate) gerekir.

questions.stem: The spread of misinformation online has ---- public trust in scientific institutions.
questions.explanation: Yanlış bilginin yayılması olumsuz etki yapar: güveni aşındırmak (erode trust).

questions.stem: Rising sea levels ---- a serious threat to low-lying coastal cities around the world.
questions.explanation: ‘pose a threat’ kalıplaşmış eşdizimdir (tehdit oluşturmak).

distractor_rationales.0: make: ‘make a threat’ tehdit etmek demektir; bağlama uymaz

questions.stem: Economists ---- that inflation will fall to around four percent by the end of the year.
questions.explanation: Gelecekteki bir düşüşü öngörmek ‘anticipate’ ile ifade edilir; ‘that’ cümlesi alır.

distractor_rationales.3: deny: inkâr etmek; gelecek tahmini için uygun değil

questions.stem: The ruins were ---- buried under volcanic ash, which is why they have survived in such good condition.
questions.explanation: İyi korunmuş olmaları tamamen (entirely) kül altında kaldıklarını gösterir; ‘which is why’ sonuç bağlar.

distractor_rationales.3: partially: kısmen; iyi korunmayı açıklamakta zayıf
distractor_rationales.2: seldom: nadiren; tek olay için uymaz

questions.stem: Children who are ---- to several languages early in life tend to learn new ones more easily later.
questions.explanation: ‘be exposed to’ (maruz kalmak) dilleri erken yaşta duymak anlamına gelir.

questions.stem: The two studies reached ---- conclusions: one found a strong link, while the other found none at all.
questions.explanation: Biri güçlü bağ, diğeri hiç bağ bulmamış: sonuçlar çelişkili (contradictory).

questions.stem: Volunteers ---- a survey of local residents to find out how the new road had affected their daily lives.
questions.explanation: Anket yapmak ‘carry out a survey’ ile anlatılır.

questions.stem: The painting had been ---- attributed to Rembrandt, but experts later proved that it was the work of his student.
questions.explanation: ‘but … proved it was his student’s work’: eser yanlışlıkla (mistakenly) Rembrandt’a atfedilmiş.

questions.stem: The discovery of antibiotics ---- medicine in the twentieth century, saving millions of lives.
questions.explanation: Milyonlarca hayat kurtarmak köklü bir dönüşüm anlatır: ‘transform’.

questions.stem: Some species can ---- extreme temperatures that would kill most other organisms.
questions.explanation: Aşırı sıcaklığa dayanmak ‘withstand’ ile anlatılır; ‘that would kill others’ karşıtlık kurar.

distractor_rationales.0: eliminate: yok etmek; sıcaklık yok edilmez
distractor_rationales.1: regulate: düzenlemek; dış sıcaklığı düzenlemek anlamlı değil

questions.stem: The number of people using public transport ---- sharply during the lockdown.
questions.explanation: Geçişsiz ‘drop’ (düşmek) sayılarla kullanılır; ‘raise/reduce’ nesne ister.

distractor_rationales.2: arose: ortaya çıkmak; sayı için uymaz

questions.stem: The minister’s remarks were deliberately ---- so that no one could accuse him of supporting either side.
questions.explanation: Hiçbir tarafı desteklediğinin söylenememesi için sözler bilerek belirsiz (ambiguous) tutulmuş.

questions.stem: Critics argue that the new law will ---- freedom of expression rather than protect it.
questions.explanation: ‘rather than protect it’ zıtlık kuruyor: özgürlüğü kısıtlamak (curtail).

distractor_rationales.2: safeguard: korumak; ‘rather than protect’ ile aynı

questions.stem: The symptoms of the disease are so ---- that it is often mistaken for a common cold in its early stages.
questions.explanation: Soğuk algınlığıyla karıştırılması belirtilerin belli belirsiz (subtle) olduğunu gösterir.

questions.stem: Despite decades of research, the precise mechanism by which the drug relieves pain remains ----.
questions.explanation: ‘Despite decades of research’ + ‘remains’: mekanizma hâlâ anlaşılamamış, ele geçmez (elusive).

distractor_rationales.3: apparent: açık; ‘despite’ ile çelişmez ama anlam ters

questions.stem: The company’s decision to ---- its operations to cheaper countries led to the loss of thousands of local jobs.
questions.explanation: Faaliyetleri başka ülkeye taşımak ‘relocate’; yerel işlerin kaybı bununla açıklanır.

questions.stem: The evidence against the suspect was largely ----, since no witness had actually seen him at the scene.
questions.explanation: Görgü tanığı yoksa delil dolaylıdır (circumstantial); ‘since’ gerekçeyi verir.

distractor_rationales.2: forensic: adli; neden cümlesiyle bağ kurmaz

questions.stem: The treaty was signed in 1990, but it did not ---- until enough countries had ratified it three years later.
questions.explanation: Bir antlaşmanın yürürlüğe girmesi ‘come into force’ kalıbıyla anlatılır.

questions.stem: Some historians regard the Industrial Revolution as the most ---- event in human history, as it reshaped almost every aspect of daily life.
questions.explanation: Günlük yaşamın her yönünü yeniden şekillendirmesi olayın dönüm noktası (pivotal) olduğunu gösterir.

questions.stem: The results of the survey should be interpreted with caution, as the sample was not ---- of the general population.
questions.explanation: ‘representative of’ (temsil edici) örneklem için kullanılır; temsil etmezse sonuçlar dikkatle yorumlanır.

distractor_rationales.0: indicative of: göstergesi; örneklem için uymaz

questions.stem: Once a thriving port, the town ---- into obscurity after the river that fed its harbour changed course.
questions.explanation: ‘Once a thriving port’ bir düşüşü hazırlıyor: kasaba unutulup gitti (fade into obscurity).

questions.stem: Although the theory was initially dismissed, it gained ---- among scientists as new evidence accumulated.
questions.explanation: ‘Although … dismissed’ zıtlık: kanıt birikince kuram güvenilirlik (credibility) kazandı.

questions.stem: The government has been accused of trying to ---- the scale of the crisis in order to avoid public panic.
questions.explanation: Paniği önlemek için krizi olduğundan küçük göstermek ‘play down’ ile anlatılır.

questions.stem: Her argument was so ---- that even those who had opposed the plan were eventually persuaded.
questions.explanation: Karşı olanların bile ikna olması argümanın ikna edici (compelling) olduğunu gösterir.

questions.stem: The drug has been withdrawn from the market after studies revealed that its side effects were ---- more serious than initially reported.
questions.explanation: Piyasadan çekilmesi etkilerin çok daha (considerably) ciddi olduğunu gösterir; ‘marginally’ geri çekmeyi açıklamaz.

distractor_rationales.2: marginally: çok az; geri çekmeyi açıklamaz

questions.stem: Deforestation not only destroys habitats but also ---- the ability of forests to absorb carbon dioxide.
questions.explanation: ‘not only destroys … but also’ aynı yönde olumsuz ikinci etki ister: yeteneği bozar (impairs).

questions.stem: The project was abandoned not because of technical problems but because it proved financially ----.
questions.explanation: Proje terk edildiyse mali açıdan sürdürülemez (unsustainable) olmalı; diğerleri olumlu.

questions.stem: The teacher asked the students to ---- their answers before handing in the test.
questions.explanation: Sınavı teslim etmeden önce cevapları kontrol etmek (check) beklenir.

questions.stem: Many tourists come to the island to ---- its beautiful beaches and clear blue water.
questions.explanation: Turistlerin gelme amacı plajların tadını çıkarmak (enjoy).

questions.stem: The flight was ---- because of heavy snow, so all passengers had to stay at the airport overnight.
questions.explanation: Yolcuların havalimanında kalması uçuşun iptal edildiğini gösterir.

questions.stem: The new policy is intended to ---- small businesses by reducing the amount of paperwork they must complete.
questions.explanation: Evrak işini azaltmak küçük işletmeleri desteklemek (support) içindir.

questions.stem: Before the vaccine can be approved, it must ---- a series of strict safety tests.
questions.explanation: Aşının testlere tabi tutulması ‘undergo tests’ ile ifade edilir.

distractor_rationales.3: overcome: üstesinden gelmek; test için uygun değil

questions.stem: The number of bees has fallen so ---- in recent years that farmers are worried about the pollination of their crops.
questions.explanation: Çiftçilerin endişesi düşüşün çarpıcı (dramatically) olduğunu gösterir.

distractor_rationales.2: gradually: yavaş yavaş; endişeyi tam açıklamaz

questions.stem: Researchers are trying to ---- why some people remain healthy into their nineties while others do not.
questions.explanation: Nedenini anlamaya çalışmak ‘figure out’ ile anlatılır.

questions.stem: The candidate’s answers during the debate were so ---- that voters found it hard to know what he actually believed.
questions.explanation: Seçmenlerin ne düşündüğünü anlayamaması cevapların kaçamak (evasive) olduğunu gösterir.

questions.stem: Although the two paintings look almost identical, experts can ---- the original from the copy by examining the brushstrokes.
questions.explanation: ‘distinguish A from B’ (ayırt etmek) kalıbı.

questions.stem: The government’s response to the crisis was widely criticised as ----, coming only after thousands of homes had already been flooded.
questions.explanation: Binlerce ev su bastıktan sonra gelmesi tepkinin geç kalmış (belated) olduğunu gösterir.
